question: Which Article of the Constitution of India is associated with the protection and improvement of the environment and safeguarding of forests and wild life?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 48 A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Article 48 A** of the Constitution of India is part of the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) under Part IV.
 
• It mandates the State to **protect and improve the environment** and to safeguard the forests and wildlife of the country.
 
• This Article was added through the **42nd Amendment Act, 1976**, which is considered a landmark amendment in Indian constitutional history.
 
• It reflects the commitment of the Indian Constitution towards **environmental conservation and sustainable development**.
 
• Article 48 A lays the foundation for various environmental protection laws and policies implemented in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976**

 
 
• Known as the "Mini-Constitution," this amendment introduced significant changes, including the addition of Article 48 A and Article 51 A (Fundamental Duties).
 
• It emphasized environmental protection as a key responsibility of both the State and citizens.
 
 
 
• **Article 51 A (g)**
 
 
• It is a Fundamental Duty that requires every citizen of India to **protect and improve the natural environment, including forests, lakes, rivers, and wildlife**.
 
• Citizens are also obligated to have compassion for living creatures.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Legislation in India**
 
 
• Key laws include the **Environment Protection Act, 1986**, **Wildlife Protection Act, 1972**, and the **Forest Conservation Act, 1980**.
 
• These laws derive their constitutional backing from Articles 48 A and 51 A (g).
 
 
 
• **Global Environmental Commitments**
 
 
• India is a signatory to major international agreements such as the **Paris Agreement** under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).
 
• The principles enshrined in Article 48 A align with global goals for sustainable development and climate action.
